definition: the act of making something work again
description: A dark flat with no power. A woman in a yellow hard hat with a headlamp stands at a wall panel, holding a pair of pliers and a bundle of coloured wires. Close-ups show gloved hands stripping a red wire and pushing it into a circuit breaker set into a broken-open wall box. A family stands in the dark hallway behind her lighting the corridor with phone torches. She works at the fuse panel, then turns to the camera smiling as the flat lights come back on.
